random.description: This is a gross pathology photograph showing a collection of dark reddish-brown, lobulated tissue masses resembling enlarged splenic tissue. The specimen appears to display multiple accessory spleens or splenogonadal fusion, characterized by distinct nodular organs of splenic parenchyma. The dark, smooth, glistening capsule is typical of normal splenic tissue, suggesting multiple distinct splenic nodules. These findings are consistent with polysplenia or multiple accessory spleens.
